description: Cross-venue PAIR GATE verdict: is BUY(buy_ex) → on-chain transfer → SELL(sell_ex) actually executable for this token? Runs the EXACT same gate as the arb engine: per-shared-chain contract IDENTITY check (same ticker + different contract = separate assets, 동명이인), withdraw@buy / deposit@sell door check per chain, chain canonicalization, and strict unknown-support skip. Returns viable, reason(s), per-chain doors, per-chain contract identity verdicts, and the chosen route chain. THE primary identity+mobility check before any cross-venue trade. Requires: base, buy_ex, sell_ex.

buy_ex.description: Buy venue (withdraw side), e.g. gateio, bithumb
